Travel agency activities (ISIC 7911) — Operator Console

read-only sample · governor-gated · every figure recomputed from the store, never from a proposal

What this actor is allowed to do

This actor coordinates the back office of a travel agency — booking / itinerary / payment-status logging, confirmation scheduling, airline-hotel-vendor settlement coordination, payment-dispute and fraud concern flagging — and, above those, the one op that faces a traveler: quoting an itinerary and a fare. It never finalizes a payment-dispute resolution or a refund / cancellation-policy override; those are a permanent structural exclusion, not an unimplemented milestone. The advisor is smart but untrusted: it only ever emits a proposal, and an independent governor recomputes the claim from the store before anything is written.

Rollout phase ladder × op

Projected directly from the travelagency.phase/phases var and governor/allowed-ops at build time — not a prose restatement. auto = may commit with no human when the governor is clean; approval = enabled but always routed to a human; disabled = the phase gate holds it. Two ops are absent from every :auto set at every phase as a structural fact, not a milestone still to come: :flag-transaction-concern and :search-fares. governor/always-escalate-ops independently agrees about the first — two layers, not one.
